text: I apply to Citi Bank saving account on XX/XX/XXXX and get rejection letter in couple of days. I give a call to number provided in the letter ( XXXX ) and was explain that further verification required. After spending couple of hours on the phone : providing all info requested and signing documents via XXXX, I was explained that my application accepted. I received a pin code for new debit card on XX/XX/XXXX ( and expected debit card in a couple of days ). Today, I received another rejection letter ( reason : unable to verify information, file number XXXX ). I give a call to XXXX XXXX again ( XXXX, fraud protection team ) and was explain that application could be ONLY PROCESSED in the branch office!!! Customers should be explained that account could be opened ONLY in the CITY BRANCH OFFICES ( why then they have a button apply online / and phone number to create new accounts )?
